purpose: Sends email and SMS messages for the payment platform.

components.name: domain-events
components.evidence: the topic with events that trigger messages

components.name: notifier
components.evidence: reads events, picks a template, renders the message, sends it to the provider and records the delivery status

components.name: Email and SMS provider
components.evidence: the external service that delivers messages

flows.evidence: the notifier hands the rendered message over to the provider for delivery
